MEDIATION  BOARDS  COMMISSION
Notice Calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
THE Mediation Boards Commission, by virtue of the powers vested in it by Section 5 (1) of The Mediation Boards Act, No.72
of 1988, invites nominations for the appointment of Chairman and Mediators in respect of resolving land disputes relating to
grievances of migrant workers and members of their families residing in Sri Lanka for the following Panel of Special
Mediation Board (Migrant Workers) in terms of Sections 3 of the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act.
Special Mediation Board Area
Kurunegala Administrative District

02.
The Mediation Boards Commission hereby gives notice calling nominations upon (A) the Individuals, (B) the Bodies,
Organizations and Institutions of non political nature, and (C) the District Secretary / Divisional Secretaries specified
hereinafter under 02 (II) to submit names of person who are eligible under 02 (I) for appointment as Mediators to the
Panel of Mediators for the said Special Mediation Board areas:
